variables.context: One supplied fitted model, sample, response unit YU and predictor unit XU; coefficients use exactly those numerical units

assumptions: The supplied fit is full-rank unweighted OLS with an intercept and one varying predictor; two coefficients consume two degrees of freedom.

limitations: This usesn-2, unlike ordinary sampleSDn-1 or unadjustedRMSEn.

models.title: t-statistic for a supplied regression coefficient estimate
models.summary: A regression coefficient t-statistic scales its deviation from a hypothesized value by its supplied standard error.

relationship.locator: Chapter13 sections13.4-13.5, ANOVA table and Equations13.4,13.5,13.9
relationship.translation_notes: All three coefficient-valued ports share one explicitly declared unit Uc. Uc is response-unit YU for an intercept or response-unit/predictor-unit YU/XU for a slope, selected uniformly before binding. (Uc-Uc)/Uc is dimensionless. This r2 replaces r1 placeholder response-unit metadata; arithmetic, source locator and independent reference oracles are unchanged. The null port is a coefficient hypothesis and the denominator its estimation uncertainty, not an observation population scale. Owner-PDF locator is retained on the project-derivation citation; the relationship source is the accessible corroboration.

variables.definition: Signed coefficient test statistic; simple-regressiondf=n-2 bound externally
variables.context: One full-rank simple OLS model with intercept, externally supplied coefficients/summary statistics, response unit YU and predictor unit XU

assumptions: Coefficient estimate, null and standard error refer to the same coefficient, model, units and covariance estimator.
Declared generic coefficient-unit binding isYU forintercept orYU/XU forslope; all three must match.
For exact simple-OLS t(n-2) inference require the classical conditional normal error assumptions andn>=3.
limitations: A supplied erroneous standard error invalidates inference; CFA Equation18 intercept standard error is separately flagged and must not be used as a verified input.
No p-value or model validity probability is returned.
